name: context-guard
description: Preserve task requirements, bounded plan state, evidence, and delegated-agent results across compaction.

interface.shortDescription: Preserve long-task context across Codex compaction.
interface.longDescription: Journals authoritative task requirements locally, mirrors bounded native-plan state, records provenance-aware delegated-agent results, verifies and reconstructs private state, restores bounded context after compaction, checks completion evidence, and exports explicit successor packs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $context-guard to protect this long-running task from context loss.
